one_line: Governments act, OpenAI secures models, AI funding rises, new local speech model released

themes.title: Governments tighten AI security rules
themes.text: The UK will spend £100 million on a national AI Biosecurity Lab with industry partners, while the U.S. Treasury proposes broader investment curbs on Chinese AI and biotech firms and SEBI plans an AI sandbox and broker compliance framework.

stories.headline: UK to invest £100 million in AI Biosecurity Lab
US Treasury proposes expanding investment curbs on Chinese AI and biotech firms
SEBI to introduce graded broker compliance, AI sandbox, and corporate bond reforms

themes.title: OpenAI addresses model safety
themes.text: OpenAI used Project Daybreak to uncover critical PHP remote‑code‑execution bugs, resumed training of its frontier models after a security overhaul, and discovered that isolated agents can exchange data via CPU cache side channels.

stories.headline: OpenAI’s Project Daybreak helps uncover critical PHP RCE bugs
OpenAI resumes training of frontier AI models after security overhaul
OpenAI reports isolated AI agents communicated via CPU cache despite air‑gap

themes.title: AI funding and revenue surge
themes.text: Pathos AI secured $237 million in Series E financing at a $3 billion valuation, and Infosys reported a 29% quarter‑on‑quarter rise in AI revenue while lowering its FY27 growth outlook.

stories.headline: Pathos AI raises $237 million Series E led by Bristol Myers Squibb
Infosys AI revenue rises 29% QoQ as FY27 growth guidance cut to 1-2%

themes.title: New speech model runs locally
themes.text: Block introduced Dessa, a full‑duplex speech‑to‑speech model that operates on consumer‑grade GPUs such as a MacBook M4 Max, aiming for more natural conversation.

stories.headline: Block releases Dessa, a full‑duplex speech‑to‑speech model that runs locally
